words.sense: careful in using money or resources and avoiding waste
careful and resourceful in making money or resources go further
unreasonably unwilling to spend or give

semantic_axes.description: whether saving involves useful reuse or ingenuity
whether refusal to spend deprives someone of a necessity

edges.boundary_rule: Frugal avoids waste; thrifty adds resourceful saving; miserly withholds spending even when it causes needless harm.
Both avoid waste; thrifty can emphasize ingenious reuse, without making frugal incorrect.

beats.text: Dev decides not to replace a working kettle just to get a newer colour, keeping the money for necessary repairs.
beats.decisive_clue: keeping the money for necessary repairs
beats.reason: Frugal emphasizes avoiding waste; thrifty is also a strong, defensible description.

hints.attention: What is saved, how is it saved, and does anybody lose something necessary?

hints.contrast: Saving through reuse differs from avoiding waste or withholding necessities.
